# CrowTerminal

AI-powered command line assistant with memory and automation capabilities for developers

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/crowterminal/.

## Actions

- **Bulk Ingest Analytics Data**: Bulk ingest up to 50 analytics data points at once to CrowTerminal.
- **Get Components Status** (read-only): Get detailed status of each CrowTerminal service component.
- **Get Data Types** (read-only): Retrieve valid data types for ingestion across platforms.
- **Get Service Status** (read-only): Retrieve CrowTerminal service status including overall health, component metrics, and uptime data.
- **Get Uptime Data** (read-only): Retrieve historical uptime data for CrowTerminal agents.
- **Ingest Analytics Data**: Ingest platform analytics data from TikTok Studio, Instagram Insights, or YouTube Analytics.
- **Update Webhook**: Update an existing webhook configuration in CrowTerminal.
- **Validate Proposed Changes**: Validate proposed changes against historical data before updating memory.
- **Analyze Agent Engagement**: Analyze engagement correlation for every field in your agent's markdown.
- **Bulk Read Memory** (read-only): Read memory for multiple clients at once (up to 50).
- **Compare Agent Markdown**: Compare your agent's markdown directly with all stored versions.
- **Create Webhook**: Register a new webhook for receiving real-time event notifications from CrowTerminal.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete an existing webhook registration.
- **Get BYOK Platform Intelligence** (read-only): Get algorithm insights for TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube without client-specific context.
- **Get Client Memory Changelog** (read-only): Retrieve human-readable change history for a client's memory.
- **Get Client Memory Pattern** (read-only): Track a specific field over time for trend analysis.
- **Get Platform Intelligence** (read-only): Retrieve algorithm insights for TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
- **Get Recent Incidents** (read-only): Retrieve list of recent incidents from CrowTerminal with duration and affected components.
- **Get Sandbox Client** (read-only): Get mock client data for testing in the sandbox environment.
- **Get Sandbox Memory** (read-only): Retrieve mock memory/skill data for testing purposes.
- **Get Status History** (read-only): Get 7-day uptime data points ready for visualization and charting.
- **Ingest Sandbox Data**: Mock data ingestion in sandbox environment.
- **List Webhooks** (read-only): List all registered webhooks for the authenticated agent.
- **Ping CrowTerminal Service** (read-only): Check CrowTerminal service availability via a simple ping endpoint.
- **Register Agent**: Self-register a new agent and obtain an API key.
- **Sandbox Engagement Analysis**: Run mock engagement analysis in the CrowTerminal sandbox environment.
- **Test Webhook**: Test a webhook URL by sending a test payload.
- **Validate Sandbox**: Mock validation endpoint for testing in sandbox.
